integrity: All entries of the finite incidence matrices and characteristic identity are checked exactly by the included dependency-free Python 3 program.
scientific_limitations: Applies only to the indicated 40-point/30-line complex configuration. No uniqueness claim or consequence for symbolic powers. Unindexed prior spectra are a priority risk; no independent review.
title: An integral Ramanujan incidence graph on the forty-point \(G_{29}\) reflection configuration
